text:
Built for society, economy, and sovereignty.
By principle. By design.

ARTPARK's approach is defined by a single, demanding question:
What does it actually take to turn a breakthrough technology from an idea to a meaningful solution, at scale?

The Technology Readiness Arc

We enter at TRL 0–3. We stay until TRL 6 and beyond.

Technology Readiness Level is a measure of maturity, from raw concept to full deployment. ARTPARK was built to operate across the entire arc, with differentiated support for each phase.

How We Build
Four forms of support. Deployed together.
01
Mentorship & Expertise

Mentorship ecosystem with domain experts, serial founders, policy advisors, government agencies and industry practitioners who engage at depth.

02
Networks & Collaborations

Industry, government ministries, and international institutions networks enable ventures to access customers, procurement channels, and deployment environments.

03
Capital & Investment

Direct investment and grant funding at pre-commercial stages when the risk is highest and most institutional capital will not move. This helps you cross the valley of death.

04
Technical Infrastructure

Access to IISc's world-class research facilities like robotics labs, fabrication shops, AI compute infrastructure, and specialized 5G testing environments at ARTGarage.

Structural Philosophy
We choose the model that fits the mission.

ARTPARK does not assume that every innovation should be a for-profit company. We assess the intended scale, the nature of the beneficiary, and the economic structure of the relevant market, and we build accordingly.

Model A - For-Profit Startup

When the technology has a clear commercial pathway, defensible IP, and a customer willing to pay for performance, we build a company.

Model B - Social Non-Profit

When the beneficiary is a population underserved by market forces, and the intervention is too important to leave to commercial incentives, we build a non-profit initiative.

Model C - Digital Public Good

When an open-access tool or platform can unlock value across an entire sector, we build it as a DPG, designed for adoption, adaptation, and national integration.

Interested in Working with Us?

Whether you are a potential partner, a researcher, or an institution interested in being part of ARTPARK, we want to hear from you.
